messages:
elaine-cs: Heads-up — Merchantly reported a behavior change after last canary. They say chat replies now start with a short prefix (e.g. 'Notice:') that wasn't there before. Customer included two example sessions.
ben-support: Can you paste the examples (redacted) and the exact API request IDs if available? We need raw prompts + system messages, not paraphrases.
elaine-cs: Pasting redacted excerpts they sent (customer asked to redact emails/ids):

Customer example 1:
```
{ "role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant." }
{ "role": "user", "content": "Summarize this product page for SKU 8342" }
```
Response (observed): "Notice: This product is...\n..." — prefixed 'Notice:' then the summary. Previously responses started directly with the summary.

Customer example 2 (same prompt, different item):
```
{ "role": "system", "content": "You are a concise assistant." }
{ "role": "user", "content": "Create a short feature list for SKU 1298" }
```
Response: "Notice: Key features include..."

They included an API request id: req-8f3b4c. Said it started after the 2026-02-10 canary (approx)."
ben-support: Thanks. @sam-ml any obvious candidates? Could be a system-message injection from a model variant or a post-processing transform in the rollout.
sam-ml: Quick guesses: 1) a new instruction template got applied to a subset of traffic (system prompt tweak). 2) a lightweight safety/formatting post-processor that prepends labels for some output categories. 3) prompt-context concatenation bug causing leftover prefix tokens in cache. Need prompt logs (full request payload including model, temp, system role), and the backend request id to fetch serving traces.
elaine-cs: I asked customer for the full request payload and to confirm region + model name. They sent this header excerpt: `x-rw-request-id: req-8f3b4c`, model: `redwood-chat-1.4.2`, region: `us-west-2`.
ben-support: Good. @nora-qa can you try to repro with the exact system+user text and model pinned to 1.4.2 locally? Keep beam/temperature same as default in UI. Log the first 3 tokens of output to see if prefix originates at model or post-process.
nora-qa: Will do. Quick note: also check rollout timeline for 1.4.2 canary — deploy-bot, did we push any response-normalization config around Feb 10? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot report: canary pool for redwood-chat-1.4.2 received an update 2026-02-10 03:42 UTC. Change-id: chg-2026-1587. Tags: "safety-normalizer-v2" added to canary route.
sam-ml: That's likely the culprit — safety-normalizer-v2 could be adding label tokens for certain content classes. Two parallel asks: (A) Support team please request the customer to run a minimal repro (curl) and include the same model header + x-rw-request-id if they re-run — example below. (B) I'll fetch the canary config and reproduce with/without normalizer.
ben-support: Example minimal repro to send to customer: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "x-rw-region: us-west-2" -H "x-rw-request-id: test-123" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1.4.2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this product page for SKU 8342"}] }'```
Ask them to keep the exact JSON and paste the full response (with headers). Also request the raw server response headers so we can see which route served it.
elaine-cs: Sent to customer with curl snippet and asked them to run with the original req id if they're able to re-run. Also asked them to share the full response + response headers and whether they used streaming.
sam-ml: I'll spin up a repro locally now toggling safety-normalizer off/on. If prefix shows only when normalizer-v2 is on, we have root cause. I'll post results in ~10m.
nora-qa: I'm also going to run an isolated unit test that checks tokenization boundary behavior when system prompt ends with punctuation — small chance of join artifact from caching.
elaine-cs: Customer replied: they'll try the curl in a few hours (can't during business hours) and will paste results. They did include an additional example showing the prefix appears only for product-summary type prompts.
ben-support: OK. Once we confirm repro, we can either rollback normalizer-v2 from canary or patch it to not add human-facing labels. Keep me posted.
sam-ml: Quick update: reproduced locally — with safety-normalizer-v2 enabled the model output is post-processed to add a short label when output length < 50 tokens. Looks like a rule intended for internal moderation, accidentally surfaced. I'll open a rollback PR and include config check to avoid user-facing labels. PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/rollouts/pull/412
nora-qa: Verified: token-boundary hypothesis not the cause. QA passing on unit checks. Recommend rollback for canary and patch the normalizer to only insert labels into internal logs (not responses).
elaine-cs: Thanks all — I'll notify the customer that we reproduced and are rolling back the canary. I'll ask them to re-test after rollback and share the test curl output.
ben-support: Good work. :+1:
note: Thread contains customer redacted examples and internal triage actions. All messages are in chronological order.
